lines.say: You don't have a maths problem. You have a forgetting problem.
Second year makes no sense, because first year's methods have faded.
Memory fades fast after you learn something. Reviewing it just before it fades makes it last. It's called spacing.
Offload builds flashcards from your own module notes, and brings each one back right before you'd forget it.
So the foundations keep coming back, not just this week's topic.
Offload. A study system that adapts when real life happens.
